value: Stealth/horror game where you dodge giant succubus girls while navigating various maze levels.

Finding yourself drawn to a dark alleyway, you are whisked away to another world, inhabited by “Squeezers”, giant girls who drain men they capture. Following the trail left by another person who disappeared in the alley, you try to find a way out of this world.
Gyakure Biyori / ぎゃくれびより
